_comment: AI-assisted add-case permutations. Run as a DispatchWrite nick: tools/.venv/bin/python tools/irc_e2e.py --scenario tools/scenarios/addcase.json --bot MechaAITest --nick <ratnick> --password <pw>. Distinct client nicks (board dedupes by client). inject uses -f to bypass the accidental-inject guard (test client nicks aren't in-channel). Expects match the ratsignal format: platform PC/Xbox/Playstation, expansion LEG/HOR/ODY, '(Code Red)', System "NAME".

steps.note: 1 inject free-text: xbox + system + code red
steps.send: !inject -f ZaraA he is in MATET on xbox and out of oxygen
!inject -f NovaQ pc odyssey, stuck at Fuelum

steps.note: 3 inject free-text: playstation + explicit system + code red
steps.send: !inject -f PaoliX playstation, system Sol, code red

steps.note: 4 inject free-text: PC horizons, oxygen OK (no CR)
steps.send: !inject -f ReiV on PC horizons at NLTT 48288, oxygen is ok

steps.note: 5 inject free-text: distinct CMDR name vs nick
steps.send: !inject -f SamW cmdr is Space Dawg, pc, at Colonia
!inject -f LucT client parle francais, pc, at Fuelum
!addcase MikeH out of fuel at Fuelum on PC odyssey

steps.note: 8 addcase terse shorthand (the case the prompt fix targets)

steps.send: !addcase AnaK she is on playstation near Beagle Point
